papers_found.title: Über die Blochsche Konstante
papers_found.relevance: Foundational paper establishing the conjectured value of Bloch's constant B. Proved lower bound B >= sqrt(3)/4 using conformal metrics. Their conjecture on B remains open.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Techniques from this paper (Ahlfors' ultrahyperbolic metric method) are foundational but the schlicht constant B_u is a different problem. Understanding the gap between their methods for B and B_u is important.

papers_found.title: Über die Blochsche Konstante und zwei verwandte Weltkonstanten
papers_found.relevance: Landau's foundational paper defining the Landau constant L and relating Bloch-type constants. Established the framework for studying these universal constants.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Historical context. The Landau constant framework informs the univalent case.

papers_found.title: The Bloch constant A for a schlicht function
papers_found.venue: Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: First study of the univalent (schlicht) Bloch constant B_u. Established initial lower bounds. Robinson's early work initiated the study of B_u as distinct from B.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Historical importance; establishes the problem. Techniques are basic by modern standards.

papers_found.title: On the Bloch-Landau constant for schlicht functions
papers_found.venue: Bulletin of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Introduced key extremal domain constructions for the univalent Bloch constant. The disk-with-removed-arcs construction that Carroll-Ortega-Cerda later refined originates here.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Goodman's domain construction approach remains the basis for the best known upper bounds on B_u. Further refinement of such domains (with more slits or different geometries) could tighten the upper bound.

papers_found.title: On a Bloch-Landau constant
papers_found.venue: Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Extended results on Bloch-Landau constants for schlicht functions, improving upon Goodman's work.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Contains early analytical techniques that may inform modern approaches.

papers_found.title: On Bloch Functions
papers_found.venue: Journal of the London Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Foundational paper on Bloch functions. Established key properties and framework used by subsequent researchers.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Provides essential background theory but not directly focused on B_u bounds.

papers_found.title: On Bloch functions and normal functions
papers_found.venue: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik
papers_found.relevance: Major paper establishing the theory of Bloch functions and their relationship with normal functions. Highly cited (499 citations).
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Background theory. Not directly focused on B_u but provides essential analytical framework.

papers_found.title: Bloch constants
papers_found.relevance: Comprehensive treatment of Bloch constants using conformal metric methods. Established key relationships between different Bloch-type constants. 40 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Minda's conformal metric approach provides tools that could be applied to improve B_u bounds through better understanding of extremal metrics.

papers_found.title: Bloch constants for meromorphic functions
papers_found.relevance: Extended Bloch constant theory to meromorphic functions. The meromorphic case provides analogies useful for the schlicht case.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Techniques may transfer to schlicht case with modifications.

papers_found.title: Marden constants for Bloch and normal functions
papers_found.relevance: Related constant (Marden constant) for Bloch and normal functions. Provides additional structural understanding of Bloch-type problems.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. Related but not directly about B_u.

papers_found.title: On the univalent Bloch constant
papers_found.relevance: Directly addresses the univalent Bloch constant B_u. Established important bounds and techniques for estimating B_u from below.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. This paper's techniques for lower bounds on B_u were later improved by Skinner (2009). Understanding and extending their approach could yield further improvements.

papers_found.title: On a variational problem of Chebotarev in the theory of capacity of plane sets and covering theorems for univalent conformal mappings
papers_found.relevance: Solved the Polya-Chebotarev problem for four symmetrically placed points. This explicit solution was crucial for Carroll-Ortega-Cerda's improved upper bound on B_u.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Fedorov's solution for 4 points was used by Carroll-Ortega-Cerda. Solving the Polya-Chebotarev problem for more general configurations could lead to better extremal domain constructions.

papers_found.title: The hyperbolic metric and Bloch constants for spherically convex regions
papers_found.relevance: Develops hyperbolic metric methods for Bloch constant problems in spherically convex regions.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Metric methods could be adapted for B_u analysis.

papers_found.title: Bloch constant and variation of branch points
papers_found.relevance: Studies the Bloch constant in relation to branch point variation. Relevant to understanding the structure of extremal functions.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. Branch point analysis is more relevant to B than B_u.

papers_found.title: On Bloch's constant
papers_found.venue: Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Landmark paper proving B > sqrt(3)/4 (strict inequality), improving on Ahlfors-Grunsky. Introduced powerful distortion theorem technique. 86 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Bonk's distortion theorem technique was adapted by Chen-Gauthier to improve the Bloch constant lower bound. Adapting this approach for the univalent case could potentially improve B_u lower bounds.

papers_found.title: Distortion Estimates for Bloch Functions
papers_found.venue: Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Establishes sharp distortion estimates for Bloch functions, extending the 1990 paper.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Distortion estimates could inform B_u lower bound approaches.

papers_found.title: The Bloch and Marden constants
papers_found.venue: Lecture Notes in Mathematics (Computational Methods and Function Theory)
papers_found.relevance: Survey chapter covering Bloch and Marden constants with open problems. Contains useful overview of the state of the art as of 1990.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Provides overview and open problems. May suggest directions for improvement.

papers_found.title: A criterion associated with the schlicht Bloch constant
papers_found.relevance: Establishes a criterion for extremal domains for the schlicht (univalent) Bloch constant. Eliminates many candidate extremal domains. Critical for understanding the structure of the B_u problem.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Jenkins' criterion constrains what extremal domains can look like. Using this criterion with modern computational methods could help identify or rule out candidate extremal configurations.

papers_found.title: Distortion theorems for locally univalent Bloch functions
papers_found.venue: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Establishes distortion theorems specifically for locally univalent Bloch functions using subordination methods. Published as TAMS 1992.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. These distortion results for locally univalent functions are directly applicable to B_u bound improvements.

papers_found.title: Sharp Distortion Estimate for Locally Schlicht Bloch Functions
papers_found.venue: Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Provides sharp distortion estimates for locally schlicht Bloch functions. 8 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Sharp distortion results for locally schlicht functions can be directly used to improve B_u lower bounds.

papers_found.title: On the locally univalent Bloch constant
papers_found.relevance: Directly addresses the locally univalent Bloch constant B_l (related to B_u). Gives new lower bound. 9 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. The locally univalent Bloch constant B_l >= B_u, so techniques improving B_l bounds may transfer to B_u.

papers_found.title: On Bloch's constant
papers_found.relevance: Improved the lower bound of Bloch's constant B using refinements of Bonk's distortion theorem approach. B > sqrt(3)/4 + 2*10^{-4}. 24 citations. Current best lower bound for B.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Chen-Gauthier's technique of refining Bonk's approach could potentially be adapted for B_u to improve the lower bound beyond 0.5708858.

papers_found.title: Distortion theorems for locally univalent Bloch functions
papers_found.relevance: Comprehensive distortion theorems for locally univalent Bloch functions using subordination theorem. Sharp growth, distortion, curvature and covering theorems. 23 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Subordination approach yields sharp results for locally univalent Bloch functions. Extending to strictly univalent case could improve B_u bounds.

papers_found.title: Distortion theorems for Bloch functions
papers_found.relevance: Extends subordination theorems to general (not necessarily locally univalent) Bloch functions. Yields sharp growth, distortion, curvature and covering results. 72 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. General Bloch function results provide context but B_u specifically requires univalence.

papers_found.title: Local Minimality Results Related to the Bloch and Landau Constants
papers_found.relevance: Establishes local minimality of the conjectured Ahlfors-Grunsky extremal functions for B and L. Shows that these functions are local minimizers in an appropriate sense. 16 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Understanding local minimality for B/L could guide the search for extremal functions for B_u. The techniques (variational methods, second-order conditions) could be adapted.

papers_found.title: A Schwarz lemma for multivalued functions and distortion theorems for Bloch functions with branch points
papers_found.venue: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Extends distortion theorem techniques to Bloch functions with branch points. Contains a Schwarz lemma for multivalued functions.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. Branch point analysis is less relevant to univalent case.

papers_found.title: Bloch constants for planar harmonic mappings
papers_found.venue: Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Establishes Bloch constants for planar harmonic mappings. Extends the classical theory to harmonic case. 119 citations. Communicated by Baernstein.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Harmonic mapping techniques may offer new perspectives on the holomorphic B_u problem.

papers_found.title: Julia's lemma and Bloch constants
papers_found.relevance: Uses Julia's lemma to investigate branch points and obtain new lower bounds of Bloch constants.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Julia's lemma technique might be adaptable to univalent setting.

papers_found.title: Bloch functions and Bloch constants
papers_found.relevance: Survey/research paper on Bloch functions and their constants. Provides lower bounds for Bloch constants B_n for functions with multiplicity at least n.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Survey provides useful context.

papers_found.title: On the locally univalent Bloch constant
papers_found.relevance: Gives a new lower bound of the locally univalent Bloch constant B_l. 12 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Directly relevant to B_u since B_l >= B_u. Their technique for B_l bounds may be adaptable.

papers_found.title: An Extension of Jenkins' Condition for Extremal Domains Associated with the Univalent Bloch-Landau Constant
papers_found.relevance: Extends Jenkins' necessary condition for extremal domains of the univalent Bloch-Landau constant. Provides stronger structural constraints on possible extremal domains. 3 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. Extended Jenkins criterion further constrains extremal domains. Combined with computational search, could help narrow down the extremal configuration for B_u.

papers_found.title: The univalent Bloch-Landau constant, harmonic symmetry and conformal glueing
papers_found.venue: Journal de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées
papers_found.relevance: CRITICAL PAPER. Obtains the best known upper bound for B_u by modifying Goodman's domain construction using Fedorov's solution of the Polya-Chebotarev problem. Introduces harmonic symmetry and conformal welding techniques. 10 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: VERY HIGH. This paper provides the best known upper bound for B_u. Their approach of using harmonically symmetric arcs could be extended with more arcs or different configurations to obtain tighter upper bounds. Computational optimization of the domain parameters could also help.

papers_found.title: The univalent Bloch constant problem
papers_found.relevance: CRITICAL PAPER. Provides the current best lower bound B_u >= 0.5708858 by improving the Beller-Hummel approach with a new implicit function technique. 2 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: VERY HIGH. This is the current best lower bound. The implicit function approach could potentially be pushed further with better estimates or computational assistance.

papers_found.title: Covering properties of meromorphic functions, negative curvature and spherical geometry
papers_found.relevance: Determines the exact spherical Bloch constant using negatively curved singular surfaces. Sharp result: arctan(sqrt(8)). Methodological tour de force.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: HIGH. The techniques (singular surfaces, conformal metrics with negative curvature) used to solve the spherical Bloch constant problem could potentially be adapted to the univalent planar case.

papers_found.title: Conformal Metrics
papers_found.relevance: Survey on conformal metrics covering Ahlfors' Lemma, SK-metrics, and the Bonk-Eremenko result. Provides self-contained introduction to the field.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Useful survey for understanding the metric approach to Bloch constants.

papers_found.title: Conformal welding and Koebe's theorem
papers_found.relevance: Foundational results on conformal welding used by Carroll-Ortega-Cerda in their construction. 58 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Conformal welding is the key technical tool for constructing the extremal domains in the Carroll-Ortega-Cerda approach.

papers_found.title: Improved Bloch and Landau constants for meromorphic functions
papers_found.relevance: Significantly improves lower bounds for Bloch and Landau constants in the meromorphic setting. Conjectures exact values. 3 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: MODERATE-HIGH. While this is for meromorphic functions, the techniques for improving lower bounds could potentially be adapted to the univalent holomorphic case.

papers_found.title: Landau and Bloch constants for meromorphic functions
papers_found.relevance: Establishes Landau and Bloch constants for meromorphic functions with a simple pole. 6 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Meromorphic function theory provides analogues that may guide holomorphic univalent analysis.

papers_found.title: Landau-type Theorem and Bloch constant for elliptic harmonic mappings
papers_found.relevance: Extends Bloch constant theory to elliptic harmonic mappings. Most recent Bhowmik-Sen paper.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. This extends to a different function class.

papers_found.title: On bounded univalent functions that omit two given values
papers_found.relevance: Studies bounded univalent functions with omitted values. Related to covering properties of univalent functions.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. Tangentially related to B_u.

papers_found.title: A remark on Bloch's constant for schlicht functions
papers_found.relevance: Early remark on B_u improving or commenting on Robinson's bounds.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. Superseded by later work.

papers_found.title: Bloch functions of the third kind and the constant
papers_found.venue: Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Studies 'Bloch functions of the third kind' related to Bloch constants.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. Historical interest.

papers_found.title: The Exact Values of the Bloch-Landau Constants
papers_found.venue: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle's Journal)
papers_found.relevance: Claims exact values of Bloch-Landau constants. Note: these claims may not have been generally accepted.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. Historical interest.

papers_found.title: Inverse function theorem on the class of holomorphic self-maps of a disc with two fixed points
papers_found.relevance: Studies invertibility on holomorphic self-maps with fixed points, discussing Bloch constant through Landau's approach. Suggests Landau's approach might deliver new lower bounds for B.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: MODERATE-HIGH. Their suggestion that Landau's approach could yield new B lower bounds is interesting. If applicable to B_u, this could be a novel angle.

papers_found.title: Bounds for the Taylor coefficients of locally univalent Bloch functions
papers_found.relevance: Coefficient bounds for locally univalent Bloch functions. Related to distortion theory.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Coefficient estimates can be used in constructing test functions.

papers_found.title: Bloch and normal functions on general planar regions
papers_found.relevance: Extends Bloch function theory to general planar regions. 10 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. General theory but not specific to B_u.

papers_found.title: Errata and Addenda to Mathematical Constants
papers_found.relevance: Updates to Finch's comprehensive reference book on mathematical constants, which covers Bloch and Landau constants.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. Reference work, useful for tracking current best bounds.

papers_found.title: The Polya-Chebotarev Problem and Inverse Polynomial Images
papers_found.relevance: Studies the Polya-Chebotarev problem computationally. This problem is key to constructing extremal domains for B_u.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: MODERATE-HIGH. Computational solution of more general Polya-Chebotarev configurations could enable new extremal domain constructions for B_u.

papers_found.title: The Pólya-Tchebotarëv problem
papers_found.relevance: Studies the Polya-Chebotarev problem with connections to the Bloch-Landau constant problem.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Further development of Polya-Chebotarev theory could improve B_u upper bounds.

papers_found.title: Four unknown constants
papers_found.relevance: Discusses four geometric constants for simply connected domains including relationships with Brownian motion and the hyperbolic metric. Provides probabilistic perspective on Bloch-type problems.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Probabilistic techniques might offer novel approaches to B_u bounds.

papers_found.title: On univalent functions, Bloch functions and VMOA
papers_found.relevance: Studies connections between univalent functions, Bloch functions and VMOA. 88 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. Background theory.

papers_found.title: Brownian motion and the fundamental frequency of a drum
papers_found.relevance: Carroll's work connecting Brownian motion with geometric properties of domains. Background for his later work on B_u.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. Background context.

papers_found.title: Sharp distortion estimates for p-Bloch functions
papers_found.relevance: Extends Bonk's distortion theory to p-Bloch functions. Contains variability region characterizations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Generalized distortion theory may offer new techniques.

papers_found.title: Landau-Bloch constants for functions in alpha-Bloch spaces and Hardy spaces
papers_found.relevance: Generalizes Landau-Bloch constants to alpha-Bloch spaces. 25 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. Different function class but related theory.

papers_found.title: Landau's theorem and Marden constant for harmonic ν-Bloch mappings
papers_found.venue: Bulletin of the Australian Mathematical Society
papers_found.relevance: Extends Landau and Marden constant theory to harmonic ν-Bloch mappings. 34 citations.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. Different function class.

papers_found.title: Singular Surfaces and Meromorphic Functions
papers_found.relevance: Develops the singular surface technique used in the Bonk-Eremenko solution of the spherical Bloch constant.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Moderate. Singular surface methodology could potentially be adapted.

papers_found.title: On bloch functions and conformal mapping
papers_found.relevance: Studies connections between Bloch functions and conformal mappings.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low-moderate. Background theory.

papers_found.relevance: Lecture by Ortega-Cerdà on Bloch functions, likely containing material related to the B_u paper.
papers_found.potential_for_improvement: Low. Likely a lecture version of published results.

current_best_bounds.B_u_upper: best from Carroll-Ortega-Cerda 2009 (numerical, approximately 0.6564 but exact value involves Fedorov's solution)

most_promising_directions: 1. Extending Carroll-Ortega-Cerda's harmonic symmetry approach with more arcs/slits to improve B_u upper bound
2. Adapting Bonk's distortion theorem technique (as refined by Chen-Gauthier) specifically for univalent functions to improve B_u lower bound
3. Using Jenkins' criterion and Carroll's extension to computationally search for and constrain extremal domain geometry
4. Solving more general Polya-Chebotarev configurations (beyond Fedorov's 4-point case) for better extremal domain constructions
5. Adapting Kudryavtseva-Solodov's suggestion of using Landau's fixed-point approach for new lower bounds
6. Computer-assisted proofs with interval arithmetic to rigorously verify numerical computations in extremal domain optimization
7. Pushing Skinner's implicit function technique further with numerical optimization
